observer_failure_reason: The observer requested MainPID from a helper that omits that property. A direct systemd query confirmed all processes had exited, then the corrected observer continued the original journal without regenerating proofs.
remaining_limitations: Explicit invocation; automatic supervision and worker replacement remain open.
Startup/dispatch and proof-export interruption, OOM/resource exhaustion, active reorg/stale results, and all-worker failure recovery remain open.
SIGKILL process crashes were exercised; machine power loss was not tested.
Matched staged repetitions, larger counts, cold-full-64/post-seal boundaries, full-size CPU proving, repeated Apple results, and the two-hour pilot remain open.
scope: Crash qualification using existing wallet proofs, one fresh shared GPU root, and cached continuation. Storage boundary exercises reuse that root in five independent journals. No delivered throughput or matched speedup claim.
timing_boundary_note: Recovery uses existing proofs and an already-published block. The overall interruption interval includes an observer repair gap. No fresh solving throughput or matched speedup is claimed.
